title: Möbius app manifest
description: Schema for mobius.json — the manifest file at the root of every Möbius app repo. See https://mobius-os.github.io/spec/manifest for prose.

id.description: App slug. Charset a-z 0-9 - _; must not start with - or _, must not be purely numeric (bare integers are reserved for the /data/apps/<id> storage path). A single character is allowed. The id is the app's own choice and need not equal the app-<repo> name (e.g. app-workout ships id 'gym').

version.description: Semver. Patch = hot rebase, minor = backwards-compatible, major = breaking.

description.description: One-line user-facing summary. The installer imposes no length cap, and curated apps run a few hundred characters; keep it short for the store UI but there is no hard limit.

entry.description: Relative path to the JSX entry file (typically index.jsx).

homepage.description: URL where users can learn more or file issues.

icon.description: Relative path to an icon image. Server resizes to 1024x1024.

static_assets.description: Prebuilt files copied into /data/apps/<slug>/static and served from /app-assets/<slug>/... and /app-assets/by-id/<id>/.... Use an array when source and destination paths are identical, or an object mapping served destination path to repo source path.

offline_capable.description: When true, Möbius caches the app shell in the service worker and exposes window.mobius.storage's write outbox so the app keeps working offline. Apps that opt in must tolerate fetch failures gracefully and use window.mobius.storage (with a fallback to plain /api/storage fetch) for writes. See the offline-runtime feature for details.

theme_color.description: Optional #RRGGBB hex. Hints the app's preferred theme/accent colour to the shell. Anything outside #RRGGBB is ignored by the installer.

background_color.description: Optional #RRGGBB hex. Hints the app's preferred background colour to the shell. Anything outside #RRGGBB is ignored by the installer.

embeds_agent.description: When true, the app embeds the Möbius chat surface (e.g. via the embedded-agent component) and the store badges it as agent-powered. Apps that set this typically also request permissions.chat_log_access.

cross_app_access.description: What this app can do to OTHER apps' storage.

share_with_apps.description: What OTHER apps can do to THIS app's storage.

chat_log_access.description: How much of the owner's chat history this app may read. 'none' (default), 'summary', or 'full'. Distinct from the storage read/write/none ladder. 'full' is accepted in the manifest so the column round-trips, but the read API rejects it until a concrete consumer ships.

manage_apps.description: Authorises POST /api/apps/install + DELETE /api/apps/{id} on the owner's behalf. Grant only to apps trusted to manage the install set (the App Store is the canonical caller).

storage_seeds.description: Map of storage paths to seed contents. String value = path to a file in the repo; object/array value = JSON-encoded literal.

default.description: Optional cron expression for a recurring schedule (e.g. '0 10 * * *'). Omit for on-demand-only jobs.

user_configurable.description: If true, seed schedule.json + arrange sync-cron.sh polling so the app UI can rewrite the schedule.

job.description: Relative path to the script run at each trigger.

imports.description: Bare specifiers already in the Möbius app-frame importmap. The canonical list lives in mobius/backend/app/runtime_libs.py and manifest.md prose mirrors it.

esm_deps.description: Libraries loaded at runtime via import('https://esm.sh/<pkg>'). Surfaced to the user on install.
